title: Romania Study Visa Pakistan — Requirements, Fees, IELTS & FAQ | SK Immigration
description: Romania study visa from Pakistan (EU): requirements, documents, fees, IELTS, low marks, timeline and FAQ. SK Immigration Services, Rawalpindi.

faqs.question: What are Romania study visa requirements from Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Admission / letter of acceptance; Proof of funds and tuition plan; Passport and forms; Medical / insurance as required. SK Immigration builds a full checklist for your case.

faqs.question: How much does it cost to study in Romania from Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Budget tuition + living + visa/insurance. Romania is generally more affordable than UK/Canada for many programmes. SK packages from PKR 50,000 cover preparation only — not tuition.

faqs.question: Do I need IELTS for Romania study visa?
faqs.answer: Many English programmes need IELTS or university English proof.

faqs.question: Can I study in Romania with low marks?
faqs.answer: Flexible options exist; we still shortlist by recognition and visa credibility.

faqs.question: How long does Romania student visa take from Pakistan?
What documents are needed for Romania student visa?
faqs.answer: Passport; Acceptance; Funds; Academics; Insurance / medicals; Housing.

faqs.question: Can I work while studying in Romania?
faqs.answer: Student work rules vary — do not rely on illegal work.

faqs.question: How to apply for Romania study visa from Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Secure admission, prepare funds/insurance/docs, then file the correct national/student visa. SK Immigration sequences the file; authorities decide.

faqs.question: What is SK Immigration’s fee for Romania study?
faqs.answer: Student packages from PKR 50,000 for preparation. Embassy and university fees are separate. No visa guarantees.

faqs.question: Do you guarantee Romania student visa approval?
faqs.answer: No. Embassies and immigration authorities decide. We prepare complete, honest files.

Romania study from Pakistan — EU, not automatic Schengen residence

Romania is often explored for lower tuition/living bands and English-taught programmes (including medicine-related interest). It is an EU destination, but travel expectations differ from Hungary/Poland Schengen residence files — verify current rules. Romanian authorities decide visas; SK Immigration prepares documentation.

Who should look at Romania

  • Budget-conscious students with realistic programme goals
  • Applicants willing to verify university recognition for future licensing (especially medicine-related paths)
  • Profiles that can show funds without illegal work assumptions

Requirements & documents (high level)

  • Letter of acceptance / admission
  • Proof of funds and tuition plan
  • Academics with required legalization
  • Insurance / medicals as listed
  • Housing evidence when requested

Process

  1. Honest pathway review (especially for medicine claims)
  2. University applications
  3. Document packaging and attestation order
  4. Visa appointment
  5. Travel readiness after decision

High-risk mistakes

  • Unverified “medical seat” sellers
  • Ignoring recognition/licensing implications for your career
  • Weak funds narrative
  • Incomplete forms and name mismatches
